conservation_statuses.description: Lemna minuta is a tiny, floating herb that is found across southern North America, throughout South America, and is invasive in Europe and Japan. With a large range extent, over 300 occurrences, and broad habitat preferences for abundant habitat, this species is considered secure.

taxon.wikipedia_summary: Lemna minuta is a species of duckweed known by the common name least duckweed. It is the smallest Lemna species. It is native to parts of the Americas, and naturalized in others; the exact native range is not known. It is found on other continents as a non-native introduction as well.
